name: start-m
title: Sign in · start
note: Google first, then email. Continue goes to the password step for every email, so nothing says whether an account exists.

name: start-320
title: Sign in · start at 320
note: The foot wraps under its link; every target stays 44px.

name: start-d
title: Sign in · start, desktop
note: One 440px panel with the sheet’s blue-to-pink edge. The venue row is the only brand flourish.

name: start-email-error-m
title: Sign in · not an email
note: Checked on Continue, before Clerk. The only thing we say about the address is its shape.

name: password-m
title: Password step
note: For every email, known or not. Change goes back with the email kept.

name: didnt-work-m
title: It didn’t work
note: One line for a wrong password, an unknown email and a code-only account. Password is cleared, email stays.

name: busy-m
title: Signing in
note: The press dims and reads Signing in…; the field locks. Padded to about 900 ms so timing gives nothing away.

name: email-code-m
title: Email me a code instead
note: Same words for every email. One input under the boxes takes paste and one-time-code autofill.

name: email-code-expired-m
title: Email code · ran out
note: The press becomes Send a new code.

name: email-code-resent-m
title: Email code · new code sent
note: A quiet note, not a toast, so it stays while they look for the email.

name: new-device-m
title: New-device code
note: Clerk’s device check after a right password. Its own eyebrow and title, so it never reads as a second password.

name: breached-m
title: Breached password
note: Clerk refuses a password found in a breach. Warning, not danger: nothing they did wrong here.

name: forgot-email-m
title: Forgot password · email
note: The email from sign-in comes along.

name: forgot-code-m
title: Code and new password
note: One screen. Padded to about 1500 ms; the same words whether or not the account exists.

name: forgot-too-short-m
title: New password · too short
note: Checked on the press, before Clerk.

name: forgot-done-m
title: Password changed
note: Clerk signs them in. About a second here, then back to where they came from.

name: google-busy-m
title: Google · opening
note: The Google press dims and reads Opening Google…; everything else locks.

name: google-returning-m
title: Google · back, signing in
note: The /sso-callback page. No form; it also holds the bot-check slot for a transfer.

name: google-cancelled-m
title: Google · cancelled
note: Back on the start with a quiet note above the button. Not red: they chose to leave.

name: google-refused-m
title: Google · new person, invite-only
note: Google proved the address, so we can say plainly there’s no account. No account is made; the card points to the invite code.

name: google-consent-return-m
title: Google · back, consent still needed
note: Only when Clerk returns legal_accepted as missing (a transfer from sign-in after launch). Same checkbox, nothing else asked.

name: code-prefilled-m
title: Invite · from a link or QR
note: The code arrives in ?code= and is checked for shape at once. They still press Continue.

name: code-typing-m
title: Invite · typing
note: Uppercased and dashed as they type. Continue wakes when the code is whole.

name: code-plain-m
title: Invite · a plain code
note: A named code (4 to 20 letters and numbers, no BETA-) is whole as soon as it is 4 long.

name: code-notfound-m
title: Invite · not found
note: Live copy.

name: code-used-m
title: Invite · already used
note: Live line, plus where to go if it was theirs.

name: code-ratelimit-m
title: Invite · too many tries
note: The field locks and the press counts down.

name: signup-m
title: Sign up · the form
note: The invite shows as Applied at the top. Consent sits above both presses, so Google waits for it too.

name: signup-unticked-press-m
title: Sign up · pressed while unticked
note: Make my account or Google, pressed unticked: the box goes red, focus moves to it, and the line is read out. Nothing is sent.

name: signup-legal-open-m
title: Sign up · Terms open
note: A link opens the live page in a sheet. Back to the form keeps every field and the tick.

name: signup-too-short-m
title: Sign up · password too short
note: Checked on the press.

name: signup-bot-check-m
title: Sign up · bot check
note: Smart CAPTCHA usually passes unseen. When it asks, its widget fills #clerk-captcha under consent and the press waits for it.

name: verify-m
title: Verify email · code
note: Step 3. Shown for every email, taken or not: a stranger learns nothing.

name: email-used-m
title: Email already used
note: The same screen as Verify, here after Send a new code. No code ever comes for a taken address, so the line under it points them to sign in.

name: signup-done-m
title: Account made · the hand-off
note: The press turns to You’re in and the step trail lights its core. Then /auth/complete redeems the invite and onboarding starts.

name: signup-launch-m
title: Sign up · after launch
note: No invite step: two steps, no Applied chip, no Beta Agreement in the consent line.

name: signup-320
title: Sign up · at 320
note: Consent wraps to three lines; the box stays top-aligned.

name: signup-legal-open-d
title: Sign up · Terms open, desktop
note: A centered dialog over the panel.

name: intent-watch-m
title: From Watch
note: The show replaces the title block. Sign in and sign up both carry it.

name: intent-crew-m
title: From a crew invite
note: The crew patch and the host’s name. Nothing about the crew’s plans, as on the invite.

name: intent-page-m
title: From a protected page
note: Named for known pages (My shows, Settings, Crews); anything else reads Sign in to keep going.

name: intent-signup-watch-m
title: From Watch, new person
note: Sign up keeps the same card through the invite code and the email check.

name: intent-return-m
title: Back on the show
note: The Watch they pressed is replayed once, with a toast. Follow and crew joins work the same way.

name: loading-m
title: Loading
note: The form’s own shape, held still. role=status reads Loading the sign-in form.

name: blocked-m
title: Sign-in blocked
note: Live copy, after 10 seconds with no Clerk. Names no browser. Try again is a full reload.

name: offline-m
title: Network dropped
note: A banner over the step they were on. Fields keep their text; the press waits until they’re back.

name: rate-limited-m
title: Rate limited
note: Clerk’s 429. The field locks and the press counts down, then wakes.

name: parts-d
title: Parts · Electric
note: Every state of every piece: field, consent, presses, Google, code boxes and the step trail.
